title: Add an installed-only filter to the agents doctor CLI
objective: Add an --installed-only option to `checkpoint agents doctor`. In JSON and markdown modes it must omit unavailable agents while preserving the existing record shape and explicit single-agent filtering. The option must be rejected or clearly ignored for `agents list` and `agents show` rather than silently changing their output. Add focused tests and keep the default command backward compatible.
acceptance_criteria: Without --installed-only, agents doctor output is unchanged.
With --installed-only, every returned doctor record has installed=true.
JSON and markdown output apply the same filter.
An explicit unavailable agent produces an empty successful doctor result rather than a fabricated installed record.
Focused CLI and capability tests cover default and filtered behavior.

operator_verification.additional_acceptance: Use deterministic installed and unavailable agent probes to verify default, JSON, markdown, explicit-agent behavior, and that agents list/show reject --installed-only or report an explicit doctor-only ignore notice.
